# AKSI — Verifiable Intelligence Infrastructure
# https://milana808.github.io/

> Vendor-neutral layer around AI runtimes: provenance, evidence, integrity, uncertainty, policy and decision receipts.

## Machine discovery
- Discovery manifest: https://milana808.github.io/.well-known/aksi.json
- Interchange protocol: https://milana808.github.io/AKSI-VAI.md
- Bridge SDK: https://milana808.github.io/bridge/aksi-bridge.js
- Integration portal: https://milana808.github.io/bridge/
- Independent verifier: https://milana808.github.io/verify/

## Product
- **Primary AKSI MATRIX workspace:** https://milana808.github.io/ — browser-local tools, deterministic calculator, opt-in public-source lookup, opt-in local history. A loaded language model is required for general free-form generation; local tool responses are not a full LLM.
- **AKSI Research Lab:** https://milana808.github.io/research/ — public research surface joining bounded semantic answers, explicit symbolic inference, Bayes calculation, convex optimization example, fold-partition demonstration, quantum state-vector simulation, local receipts, the browser-native AKSI Q interpreter and persistent local memory. It is not AGI or a general-purpose language model.
- Interactive AI surface: https://milana808.github.io/ask.html
- Trust / AI Evidence Passport: https://milana808.github.io/trust/
- Enterprise overview: https://milana808.github.io/offer/
- AKSI Quantum Answer Engine: https://milana808.github.io/quantum-mind/ — browser-local WebLLM prototype with candidate answers and explicit scoring; evaluator output does not independently establish truth.
- AKSI Proof Engine: https://milana808.github.io/aksi-engine/ — local-first hypothesis lab with competing explanations, falsifiable test plans, weighted evidence ledger and JSON export. Heuristic score is not a probability of truth.
- AKSI Context Compiler: https://milana808.github.io/context-compiler/ — local-first portable AI memory; compile facts, decisions, constraints and tasks into Markdown/JSON; encrypted AES-GCM backup and import; no cloud sync.
- AKSI Counterfactual Lab: https://milana808.github.io/counterfactual-lab/ — offline-first decision simulation with seeded repeatability, uncertainty perturbation and sensitivity tests. Scenario outputs are not real-world probabilities.
- AKSI Quant: https://milana808.github.io/quant/ — paper-trading research lab; it does not place real orders.

## What AKSI is
AKSI is a model-neutral verification and research infrastructure around AI runtimes. It combines task definition, evidence provenance, bounded inference, uncertainty, policy, reproducibility and decision receipts. It is not a claim of AGI or a replacement for foundation models.

## Interoperability
Designed for OpenAI-compatible HTTP APIs, MCP ecosystems, browser-local models, self-hosted inference and ordinary HTTP services. A bridge does not grant execution authority; policy and action gateways remain separate.

## Truth discipline
A cryptographic signature proves integrity and key association, not factual truth. A hash detects changes relative to a known digest; it does not establish authorship or trusted time. Observation → hypothesis → supported → verified is an evidence/status discipline, not a claim that every AI output is correct.

## Research and experiments
- AKSI Reality Engine: https://milana808.github.io/reality-engine/ — local-first decision workspace for hypotheses, alternatives, tests, outcomes and browser-local SHA-256 receipts.
- AKSI Evidence Passport: https://milana808.github.io/evidence/ — source-linked claim review and portable evidence records; not an automatic fact-checker.
- AKSI Trace Ledger: https://milana808.github.io/trace/ — local-first hash-chain journal; integrity does not prove truth, authorship or trusted time.
- AKSI Evidence Lifecycle: https://milana808.github.io/evidence-lifecycle/ — experimental portable evidence records and structural checks.
- AKSI Training Lab: https://milana808.github.io/training-lab/ — character n-gram training with train/test split and perplexity.
- AKSI Neural Lab: https://milana808.github.io/neural-lab/ — small CPU MLP with backpropagation, exposed weights, train/test metrics and export. It is not a large language model.
- AKSI Quantum Lab: https://milana808.github.io/quantum-lab/ — classical state-vector simulator; not quantum hardware and no general quantum advantage claim.
- **AKSI Q language:** https://github.com/MILANA808/milana808.github.io/tree/main/aksi-language — executable experimental language with a Python reference interpreter and browser-native JavaScript runtime. The public editor is part of the Research Lab.
- **AKSI Q source:** https://github.com/MILANA808/milana808.github.io/tree/main/aksi-language
- **AKSI Q browser runtime:** https://github.com/MILANA808/milana808.github.io/blob/main/aksi-q-browser.js
- **AKSI persistent memory:** IndexedDB local to the current browser and origin; explicit save/search/delete, JSON export/import and SHA-256 integrity checks. Storage is quota-limited, not infinite, not cloud-synchronized and not automatically populated from conversations.

## Security and limitations
- Differential privacy end-to-end and formal verification of critical paths are research requirements, not capabilities claimed as complete by this page.
- Browser-local private keys and signing experiments must not be treated as production identity or money custody without separate security review.
- High-impact decisions require independent sources, human review and domain-specific validation.
- Never describe heuristic scores as calibrated truth probabilities, quantum simulation as quantum hardware, or checksums as proof of truth.
